summary: The filing reports minutes of COMPANHIA PARANAENSE DE ENERGIA - COPEL's 71st Annual and 213th Extraordinary General Meetings held on April 23, 2026, covering routine agenda items: approval of 2025 management report and financial statements, 2026 capital budget, allocation of net profit, and dividend distribution. No special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine meeting circular as a Form 6-K. This is equivalent to a domestic issuer filing a proxy statement for an annual meeting.
